definitions.explanation: A pattern of stripes running vertically (top to bottom). Common in clothing and fabric design.

examples.japanese: {縦縞|たてじま}のシャツを{着|き}ている。
examples.english: He's wearing a vertically striped shirt.

examples.japanese: {縦縞|たてじま}の{柄|がら}は{体|からだ}を{細|ほそ}く{見|み}せる{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: A vertical stripe pattern has the effect of making the body look slimmer.

examples.japanese: {紺|こん}と{白|しろ}の{縦縞|たてじま}のネクタイを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a navy and white vertically striped tie.

notes:
{縦縞|たてじま} is a pattern of stripes running vertically, commonly seen in clothing, fabric, and design.

COMPOSITION:
{縦|たて} (vertical) + {縞|しま} (stripes).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦縞|たてじま}のシャツ: vertically striped shirt
- {縦縞|たてじま}の{柄|がら}: vertical stripe pattern
- {縦縞|たてじま}のユニフォーム: pinstriped uniform

CONTRAST:
- {縦縞|たてじま}: vertical stripes
- {横縞|よこじま}: horizontal stripes
- ストライプ: stripes (loanword, used in fashion contexts for either direction)

FASHION NOTE:
{縦縞|たてじま} is widely believed to have a slimming visual effect. In baseball, pinstriped uniforms ({縦縞|たてじま}のユニフォーム) are iconic, particularly associated with certain professional teams.
